developments.name: City Plus
developments.tagline: Mixed-use tower near the Sarbet roundabout
developments.summary: A 3B+G+23 mixed-use tower in Sarbet offering one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments from 76 m², available fully finished or semi-finished.
developments.description:
City Plus is Temer Properties' mixed-use tower in Sarbet, close to the roundabout and the African Union headquarters area. The building rises three basement levels, a ground floor and 23 upper floors.

A typical floor combines one-bedroom units with one bathroom, two-bedroom units with two bathrooms, and three-bedroom units with two bathrooms and a maid's room. The developer offers units fully finished or semi-finished, and states an estimated delivery period of 36 months.
developments.reviewNotes: Body text of the City Plus listings on temerproperties.com duplicates Sarbet Blue Point content; facts here come from the structured listing fields, listing excerpts and the May 2026 City Plus catalogue. Construction stage not stated. A developer pop-up advertises 'from ETB 120,000 per m²' for a Sarbet project near the roundabout - confirm in writing whether this applies to City Plus before publishing any price.
